en-CA.notes: Canadian English source locale and development-region fallback.

en-US.notes: Apple catalog has separate locale slots, but regional copy has not been adapted or reviewed; do not claim support yet.

ckb.notes: Central Kurdish (Sorani), RTL. Draft Apple strings use Android terminology for consistency and need fluent linguistic and device-layout review.

kmr.notes: Northern Kurdish (Kurmanji), LTR. Apple builds this catalog as ku-Latn to preserve the Latin-script distinction; draft strings use Android terminology for consistency and need fluent linguistic and device-layout review.
